name: OpenEarthMap: Benchmark for Global High-Resolution Land Cover Mapping
description: OpenEarthMap is a benchmark dataset for global high-resolution land cover mapping from high-resolution optical remote sensing imagery. It contains 5,000 aerial and satellite images of 1,000x1,000 pixels at 0.25–0.5 meter ground sampling distance (GSD), manually annotated with dense pixel-level raster labels across 8 land-cover classes: Bareland, Rangeland, Developed space, Road, Tree, Water, Agriculture land, and Building. The dataset spans 97 regions across 44 countries on six continents, capturing substantial geographic, biome, urban-structure, and seasonal diversity to evaluate global out-of-domain model generalizability.
